parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with an indication for pain. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno and filter by mesh_heading = 'pain'. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id AS indication_curie, efo_term AS indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
